Internal helper: find a workspace vector that a computed term recycles

Source: R/classify.R
dot-jst_formula_recycled.Rd

A name inside a computed term that is not a variable resolves in the formula's environment (the S322 constant rule), and nothing checked its length: with v <- c(1, 2, 3), I(Stress * v) fitted on R's recycled 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, ... behind its "longer object length" warning – with no warning at all when the row count divides by the length – and lm() does the same (Session 324, the S323 item). This hands each computed term of the formula, both sides, to .jst_recycled_operand(), which says what counts as recycled.

Usage

.jst_formula_recycled(formula, data, enclos)

Arguments

formula

The analysis formula as typed.

data

The analysis data frame, after the pipeline's filters.

enclos

The environment the formula's other names resolve in.

Value

NULL when there is none; otherwise the .jst_recycled_operand() result.
